meta.description: Registry for formal boundary-case classes and their meanings in the Mono-Process Formal Law Program.

boundary_case_classes.meaning: The admissibility window becomes empty, degenerate, or unable to receive projected candidates.
A locus changes classification across the null/non-null threshold.
Residue state changes enough to alter admissibility, transport, or equivalence class membership.
Orientation frame shifts enough to alter minimization, transport, or admissibility.
Multi-valued continuation branches exceed declared pruning or bounded-width conditions.
Pruning eliminates all candidate continuation branches.
Transport leaves declared admissible or locally closed transport domain.
The admissible image of continuation candidates is empty.
Equivalence relation fails due to boundary drift, operator action, or context change.
